# Shiba Dev — full agent summary

Shiba Dev builds operational intelligent systems under contract. We are not a consumer AI tools marketplace and we do not publish prices.

## Organization
- Name: Shiba Dev
- Parent: The Shiba Inu Media Company Inc.
- Locations: Hong Kong · Vancouver
- Site: https://shiba-dev.com/
- Email: hello@shiba-dev.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/shiba-dev/

## Positioning
We do not sell AI tools — we deliver operational intelligent systems: bilingual brand sites, multilingual digital representatives constrained to an approved knowledge base, and product work on ArtistAgent.AI / ShibaOS.

## Clinics & professional services
Systems for clinics and professional services focus on intake and operations only: WhatsApp, hotline, and FAQ first-response on an approved knowledge base, with clear human handoff. We do not provide clinical advice, medical freelancing, or legal counsel through demos or agents.

## Engagement
Commercial work starts with a 30-minute Discovery Call. Scope, proposal, build, and ops follow Discovery. No public starting prices.

## Demo worlds
Public demos under /demos/ (Lumina, Veritas, Aurora, Velocity, Luna, Nexora) and related stage examples are fictional illustrations of architecture patterns. They are not real client deployments or case studies.
